document.abstract: The B.H.P. Inc. Touchvision Editing System is an editor designed to edit film on video. Design was based on ease of editing and accurate relationship of the video medium to the actual film frames. Other design features considered were: freedom from keyboard manipulation, familiarity with “flat bed” style editing. The basic editor system and support systems allows for a complete video editing environment, which is faster and more economical than traditional film editing.
